operation: On a separate Show created through the actual wizard, intercepted one real save request with a controlled HTTP 503: the existing rollback banner appeared, the animation draft stayed open, storage remained unchanged, and retry saved the requested 30% track. Delayed an actual HTTP 200 removal response: mutation fields stayed disabled while Escape/reopening worked, and releasing the response left the newer animation popover open without an obsolete refusal; Undo restored the saved track.
